The Energy Department, Government of Punjab requires an end-to-end EPC delivery model across twelve operational public hospitals: site surveys; system engineering; supply of compliant equipment; installation (civil, structural, and electrical); testing and commissioning; grid synchronization; and sustained outcomes through three (3) years of O&M with performance guarantees.

We understand that “success” for this program is not only achieving 5 MW aggregate generation, but doing so safely within live healthcare environments, with minimal disruption to patient-care operations and with auditable compliance to the RFP’s technical and procurement conditions. Our experience delivering solar deployments [CAP-032][CAP-008][CAP-020] alongside work executed for federal and provincial government clients in Pakistan [CAP-020][CAP-008][CAP-042] aligns with the Department’s need for disciplined planning, stakeholder coordination, and formal documentation.

For each hospital, we will treat the survey and design phase as the risk-reduction gate: rooftop/space verification, shading and structural considerations, electrical interfacing, and an installation method statement tailored to hospital constraints. We also recognize the requirement that all electrical works comply with IEC 62548 and the Pakistan Electricity Code.

Two items are pivotal to grid-tied operability: (i) DISCO-facing net-metering approvals and (ii) SCADA-based monitoring with a central dashboard. Our library does not yet evidence DISCO net-metering facilitation or SCADA dashboard deployments for solar; we will address these mandatory requirements through specialist partnering and dedicated hires during mobilization.

We understand the requirement for staff training and will deliver structured handover and training for hospital engineering teams. We can assign a PMP-certified project leadership resource, evidenced through prior PMP-certified engagements [CAP-005][CAP-027], and our ISO 9001-aligned quality discipline is evidenced on delivered projects [CAP-030][CAP-022][CAP-039].
